backcard_card_name: Cell, The Greatest Threat to Mankind
backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] Unless there are 1 or more cards of both <Android 17> and <Android 18>―both green and with an energy cost of 2―under this card, you can’t activate [Z-Awaken].
[Auto][Once per turn] When you use one of your opponent’s Battle Cards in a combo, this card gets +5000 power until the end of your opponent’s turn.
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card, choose up to 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards with an energy cost of 3 or less from your Drop or your opponent’s Battle Area and place it under this card.
card_text:
[Auto] When this card is placed in your Leader Area, place up to 1 {Gingertown} from your deck in your opponent’s Battle Area.
[Activate : Main] Switch this card to Rest Mode and place 1 green 《Android》 from your hand at the bottom of your deck : Draw 2 cards.
[Awaken] When your life is at 5 or less or there is a green <Cell> with an energy cost of 3 in play : Play up to 1 <Android 17> and 1 <Android 18>―both green and with an energy cost of 2―from your deck to your opponent’s Battle Area, shuffle your deck, then add cards from your life to your hand until you have 5 life left.
